overall_assessment: Reviewed all 28 fetched-page samples (20 suspects and 8 random controls) and all 12 additional failed-fetch entries. Sixteen suspects have empty extraction despite substantial plan content, but all are absent from the build, suggesting a coverage/join problem rather than demonstrated selector loss; all eight controls retain clean, readable plans. The two short/uncaptured shells are correctly excluded, the two year flags reflect 2023 theme labels without independently establishing a wrong historical version, and the failed URLs follow the expected pattern, so no URL defect is established; omitted semester pickers, sidebar schedules and department contact boxes, source-level repetition/inconsistent facts, and packet truncation markers are not extraction findings.

findings.description: All 16 empty/uncaptured suspects have zero extracted characters while their fetched pages contain substantial course-specific descriptions, outcomes and, where visible, assessment or other plan sections. These are genuine missing-text observations in the audited output, not unavailable-plan shells. However, every affected entry says "not in the build (pilot run)", unlike the two correctly dropped shells; no loss from an included production plan is demonstrated. The eight random controls extract successfully, so this is concentrated in the unmatched older offerings rather than an institution-wide failure of plan selection.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/pipeline.R::harvested_rows() removes harvest-time text and left-joins data/interim/extracted_text.RDS by exact course_id. R/audit/prepare_fulltext.R labels any ID absent from course_offerings.RDS as "not in the build (pilot run)". The perfect coincidence of empty text and absent build IDs suggests stale derived artifacts or unmatched offering IDs; a failing UiB selector is not established by this packet.
findings.suggested_fix: Rebuild the derived extraction/build artifacts from the same raw-store snapshot, then regenerate this packet. In harvested_rows()/prepare_fulltext.R, preserve an explicit extraction-row match indicator and distinguish an unmatched course_id from a matched row whose extraction is empty; fail or separately label unmatched audit rows. If course_id changes across snapshots, reconcile only through a validated stable offering key. For any matched rows still empty, run page_blocks() on their stored HTML before changing the UiB selector.
